title: Plus Size Pocket Satin Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This plus size satin midi dress features a structured bodice, defined waist and flowing A line skirt for an effortlessly elegant look. The smooth satin finish brings elevated polish while hidden pockets add comfort and ease. Perfect for wedding guests, rehearsal dinners, cocktail parties, formal dinners and evening celebrations.

?

Size Tip: Please choose your size based on bust and waist measurements. If your bust and waist fall into different sizes, we recommend choosing the larger size.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
